claim: Macie sensitive data discovery jobs can analyze 5 TB per account per month by default; the quota applies only to sensitive data discovery jobs, and you can increase it to as much as 1,000 TB (1 PB) through the Service Quotas console.

qualifiers.scope: per account per month, in each AWS Region

evidence.quote:
Monthly analysis per account by sensitive data discovery jobs: 5 TB

  This quota applies only to sensitive data discovery jobs.
To increase the quota to as much as 1,000 TB (1 PB), use the [Service Quotas console](https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home).
Unless otherwise noted, each quota applies to your account in each AWS Region.
